english.note: Use this colloquial, somewhat vivid choice when someone is being particularly unyielding or difficult.

examples.english: This customer is really stubborn; even after talking for so long, they still won't agree to a refund.
examples.traditional: 呢個客真係牛皮，講咗咁耐都唔肯退款。
